title: Processor analysis FIFO push, CMakeLists
description:
Be the sole PluginProcessor + CMakeLists.txt owner for phase H. Push analysis frames into AnalysisFifo from processBlock (non-blocking), tick message-side consumers at a safe rate, and register all Analysis sources plus AnalysisTests.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp phase-G prepare/processBlock order and existing members
- Source/Analysis/* public APIs from h.1–h.4 (AnalysisFifo, PerformanceHistory, NoiseFingerprint, AlignmentScopeData, AttackIntegrityAnalyzer, TailIntegrityAnalyzer)
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §20, §28.1–28.2 (AbstractFifo transfer; drop frames; never block audio; disabled analyzers reduce CPU)
- Existing CMakeLists.txt target_sources and test registration patterns from prior phases
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for any analyzer quality / visual enable parameters if present

PluginProcessor (realtime-safe push):
- Members: AnalysisFifo plus (as needed for lifetime) PerformanceHistory, NoiseFingerprint, AlignmentScopeData, AttackIntegrityAnalyzer, TailIntegrityAnalyzer. Prefer owning the FIFO and drain on timer/AsyncUpdater/message callback; integrity analyzers and fingerprint/scope are message-thread only.
- processBlock: after envelopes/state/gain are known for the block, fill AnalysisFrame from already-computed control values (key envelope, main envelope, thresholds, noise floor, state, gain, transient, sustain confidence, alignment offset if available). tryPush — if full or QualityMode Off, skip. Never allocate, lock, or call GUI from audio thread.
- Quality modes Off/Live/Studio/Diagnose: Off disables push; Live may push every Nth block; Studio/Diagnose push more frequently (document). Disabling must reduce work materially (no heavy copies when Off).
- prepareToPlay: prepare AnalysisFifo and any owned analysis units with fixed sizes. Optional Timer/AsyncUpdater drains FIFO → PerformanceHistory::pushFromFrame and optionally refresh NoiseFingerprint/AlignmentScopeData from existing learn/align snapshot getters when available.
- Do NOT build Performance Timeline GUI components (phase I).

CMakeLists.txt (phase-H sole owner):
- Add AnalysisFifo.cpp, PerformanceHistory.cpp, NoiseFingerprint.cpp, AlignmentScopeData.cpp, AttackIntegrityAnalyzer.cpp, TailIntegrityAnalyzer.cpp to plugin/library target_sources
- Register tests/AnalysisTests.cpp on the existing test executable/target (body filled in h.6)
- Additive only — do not restructure unrelated targets

Do NOT rewrite Analysis unit implementations (h.1–h.4). Do NOT implement test bodies (h.6).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp own and prepare AnalysisFifo and required analysis members
processBlock tryPushes AnalysisFrame data without blocking when QualityMode is not Off
QualityMode Off skips analysis push work
Message/timer path drains FIFO into PerformanceHistory (or documents equivalent consumer wiring)
CMakeLists.txt lists AnalysisFifo.cpp, PerformanceHistory.cpp, NoiseFingerprint.cpp, AlignmentScopeData.cpp, AttackIntegrityAnalyzer.cpp, and TailIntegrityAnalyzer.cpp
CMakeLists.txt registers tests/AnalysisTests.cpp on the test target
No heap allocation or mutex wait introduced on the audio path after prepareToPlay from analysis push
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: allocate or lock on the audio/process thread
implement Performance Timeline / Diagnose GUI components

allowed: add member instances and includes for phase H analysis units on PluginProcessor
use juce::Timer or AsyncUpdater for FIFO drain on message thread
subsample Live mode pushes every N blocks
read QualityMode from APVTS when ParameterIDs exist, else default Live or Studio
add CMake target_sources for all phase H Analysis cpp files and AnalysisTests.cpp
forbidden: reimplement FIFO, history ring, fingerprint, scope, or integrity math inside PluginProcessor beyond API calls
own or rewrite Source/Analysis/* implementation files
expand scope into phase I GUI painting of the timeline
block audio thread if FIFO is full
